text:
Ivy: Quick help please — Atlas POC is getting mixed 429s across /v1/embeddings.batch and /v1/chat.generate during a combined ingest + demo run. Demo in 45m. They say failures started ~08:20 PT.

Tom: Do we have tenant id, batch sizes, concurrency, and model variants?

Ivy: Tenant atlas-poc-2. They were running two parallel ingest workers (embeddings) sending batches of 400 and 3 chat processes hitting chat.generate with ~900 token prompts. Model variants: embed-pro-v1 and chat-pro-v1.

Nadia: Two separate pressure points: embeddings token bursts and chat inflight tokens. Any sample 429 body?

Ivy: Customer pasted this single response:

```
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
{"error":"rate_limit","retry_after_ms":1100,"route":"/v1/embeddings.batch","tenant_id":"atlas-poc-2","tokens":132000}
```

Tom: That looks like per-route burst exhaustion for embeddings. But chat processes may also be contributing to tenant-level token budget. Ask customer to pause the larger batch worker and retry with batch_size=128, concurrency=1 to confirm.

Ivy: They've paused one worker and retried a small batch test at 08:28. No 429s for 3 minutes. They can pause the whole ingest for now but want a way to finish the demo later.

limit-bot: [automated] Override API: POST /internal/admin/overrides {"tenant_id":"<id>","route":"<route>","tokens_per_min":<n>,"duration_min":<m>}  infra approval required for overrides.

Nadia: For a short demo bump I can apply tokens_per_min=280000 for 40 minutes on /v1/embeddings.batch for atlas-poc-2. Alternatively we can top up tenant token budget if the 429 code indicates token_budget_exhausted. Which do you prefer?

Rex: Customer wants the ingest finished for the demo. Approve the per-route bump for 40m. Log it in the deal notes.

Nadia: Applying override now. Override ID ov-20260420-13 applied at 08:35Z.

limit-bot: [automated] Override ov-20260420-13 applied for tenant atlas-poc-2: /v1/embeddings.batch tokens_per_min=280000 duration_min=40 by Nadia.

Ivy: Told Atlas to resume at 08:40 and to run only one ingest worker with batch=256 while we monitor. Also sent client guidance: respect Retry-After, use exponential backoff with full jitter, and prefer streaming for chat where possible.

Tom: For follow-up: add recommended POC profile for mixed workloads (e.g., embeddings: batch <=256, concurrency 2-4; chat: streaming or concurrency <=3) and add a checklist item to verify client retry logic before load tests.

Nadia: Monitoring now. No more 429s in the 25m window after resume. I scheduled revert at 09:10Z but will revert early if safe.

limit-bot: [automated] Override ov-20260420-13 scheduled end 09:15Z.

Rex: Noted temporary concession in CRM and set follow-up call to review permanent quota needs if they plan sustained throughput.

Ivy: Demo completed successfully at 09:00. Closing thread, will reopen if anything else pops up. :tada:
